title: Work IQ: Context IQ adds agents, skills and content sources to the prompt menu
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap record and the current Microsoft documentation for Context IQ, agent management and licensing. The updated Work IQ overview still supports the background claims; the expansion's default, detailed choices and menu-specific controls remain unpublished.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft plans to expand Context IQ to discover and select additional agents, skills and content sources while composing prompts.
claims.quote: Expand Context IQ so users can discover and select additional agents, skills, and content sources while composing prompts.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Open questions; rationale: risk

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe this Context IQ expansion.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Which additional agents, skills and sources will appear is not stated.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: At rollout

claims.quote: Searched: "Context IQ" agents skills expanded menu default rollout licence pricing; opened roadmap record, Copilot release notes, Context IQ support article and Work IQ overview. No expansion rollout mechanism or unchanged-behaviour statement found.

claims.where: controls[0]; summary; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: No tenant-wide UI switch or API operation for the expanded Context IQ choices is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Context IQ" admin tenant switch setting Graph API enable disable; opened Context IQ support, agent actions, registry, package block/list, Work IQ overview and Business Applications default settings. No switch or call for the expanded menu found.

claims.claim: The mixed licensing model reflects included declarative agents and metered shared-tenant-data agents alongside Copilot Chat entitlement.
claims.quote: Declarative agents that are grounded in instructions and public websites are included with Copilot Chat (Basic), and Microsoft 365 Copilot (Basic) and (Premium). ... agents that access shared tenant data, such as SharePoint or Graph Connector content, are billed based on metered consumption.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Risk assessment: Change & support; Scope; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified which expanded Context IQ choices each licence or Work IQ button state will show.
claims.quote: Searched: "Context IQ" agents skills expanded menu default rollout licence pricing; opened Context IQ support, Copilot requirements, Purchase and manage agents in Copilot Chat and Work IQ overview. Existing licence splits are documented, but no split for the additions.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No separate price or charge for the new menu interaction is published.
claims.quote: Searched: "Context IQ" agents skills expanded menu default rollout licence pricing; opened Work IQ overview Access and pricing, Purchase and manage agents in Copilot Chat, Copilot requirements, Context IQ support and release notes. No menu-specific price found.

claims.claim: Context IQ already exists in Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: Context IQ now allows you to search for and select Microsoft Teams channels when creating prompts in Copilot Chat, so responses are grounded in a specific channel instead of across all Teams content.

claims.claim: The Teams-channel Context IQ release-note entry is under 10 March 2026.
claims.quote: ## March 10, 2026 ... Scope Copilot Chat prompts to Teams channels with Context IQ [Web]

claims.claim: Users can search for and select a Teams channel in Context IQ to ground responses in that channel.
claims.quote: Context IQ now allows you to search for and select Microsoft Teams channels when creating prompts in Copilot Chat, so responses are grounded in a specific channel instead of across all Teams content.

claims.claim: Typing / in Copilot Chat opens the references menu for selecting prompt content.
claims.quote: To reference a specific piece of information, type **/** and begin typing the people, file, meeting, or email you wish to link.

claims.claim: The existing references menu supports files.
claims.quote: People, Microsoft 365 files, meetings, and emails are accessible through tabs.

claims.claim: The existing references menu supports people.
claims.quote: People, Microsoft 365 files, meetings, and emails are accessible through tabs.

claims.claim: The existing references menu supports meetings.
claims.quote: People, Microsoft 365 files, meetings, and emails are accessible through tabs.

claims.claim: The existing references menu supports emails.
claims.quote: People, Microsoft 365 files, meetings, and emails are accessible through tabs.

claims.claim: The references menu supports Teams chats and channels.
claims.quote: Copilot suggests your relevant Teams group and meeting chats based on recent activity and number of participants under the **Chats** tab. Copilot also displays your recently used Teams channels under the **Channels** tab.

claims.claim: The references menu supports SharePoint sites and lists.
claims.quote: Copilot displays SharePoint sites, pages, and lists that you've recently interacted with or were shared with you. Select a site to scope your prompt to its contents.

claims.claim: The references menu supports content from Copilot connectors.
claims.quote: You can now ground your Copilot prompts on third-party data using your organization's Graph Connector content, accessible from the references menu in Copilot Chat.

claims.claim: The cited Context IQ support article lists no agents or skills as reference types.
claims.quote: Searched: "Context IQ" "agents" "skills"; opened and read the complete Refer to specific files and more support article, including every Reference specific types of content subsection. No agent or skill reference type listed.

claims.claim: References suggestions are based on scanning the user's files, emails, conversations and other Microsoft 365 apps and services.
claims.quote: When you initiate the references menu, relevant content is suggested based on scanning of your files, emails, conversations, and other Microsoft 365 apps and services.

claims.claim: Copilot refers to the content the user includes as part of its response.
claims.quote: Copilot refers to the content you include as part of its response.

claims.claim: Work IQ actions are user scoped.
claims.quote: Actions are user scoped, meaning every request runs in the context of a specific user and only accesses what that user is allowed to see or do.

claims.claim: A Work IQ request only accesses what its user is allowed to see or do.
claims.quote: Actions are user scoped, meaning every request runs in the context of a specific user and only accesses what that user is allowed to see or do.

claims.claim: The Work IQ overview does not state that its request-level permission description covers the Context IQ menu.
claims.quote: Searched: "Context IQ" agents skills identity actions governance block Work IQ; read Work IQ overview Security, authorization, and governance and Context IQ support. No statement identifying the expanded menu as a Work IQ API request found.

claims.claim: The Work IQ overview says every tool invocation is logged and evaluated.
claims.quote: Every tool invocation is logged and evaluated, enabling auditability, usage analytics, rate limiting, and real-time compliance enforcement across agents and data sources.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether selecting an agent or skill in Context IQ follows the documented Work IQ tool invocation path.
claims.quote: Searched: "Context IQ" agents skills identity actions governance block Work IQ; opened Work IQ overview and Context IQ support and searched Copilot release notes for the expansion. No selection-to-tool-invocation mechanism documented.

claims.claim: The identity under which an agent selected through expanded Context IQ runs is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: "Context IQ" agents skills identity actions governance block Work IQ; opened Work IQ overview, agent management and Context IQ support. Work IQ API identity is stated, but no identity mechanism for the expanded menu is identified.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified whether agents or skills selected through expanded Context IQ only read content or also take actions.
claims.quote: Searched: "Context IQ" agents skills identity actions governance block Work IQ; opened roadmap record, Work IQ overview, agent management and Context IQ support. General agent actions are documented, but not the expanded menu's execution behaviour.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: The Manage agents page says organisation members can only access agents the administrator has allowed.
claims.quote: Members of your organization can only access the agents that you have allowed.

claims.claim: For users with a Microsoft Copilot licence and Work IQ on, the support article documents references to people, files, meetings and emails.
claims.quote: ## Users with a Microsoft Copilot license (Microsoft Copilot users) ... ### Work IQ turned on ... People, Microsoft 365 files, meetings, and emails are accessible through tabs.

claims.claim: Users without a Microsoft Copilot licence can reference only files in the references menu.
claims.quote: Only files are available to reference for users without a Microsoft Copilot license.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: Only files are available in the references menu when Work IQ is off.
claims.quote: Only files are available to reference when you've turned off **Work IQ** in chat.

claims.claim: The support article describes Work IQ as a user-controlled button at the top right of the chat page.
claims.quote: At the top right of the chat page, turn off the **Work IQ** button.

claims.claim: Work IQ API usage consumes Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Work IQ API usage consumes Copilot Credits shared with other eligible services.

claims.quote: Work IQ API usage consumes Copilot Credits shared with other eligible services.

claims.claim: The API billing documentation does not state that the new Context IQ menu selection itself is metered.
claims.quote: Searched: "Context IQ" agents skills expanded menu default rollout licence pricing; opened Work IQ overview Access and pricing and Purchase and manage agents in Copilot Chat. API and agent usage billing are stated; a charge for the menu interaction is not.

claims.quote: Select **Agents** > **All agents**. ... In the **All agents** page, select an agent from the list of agents. ... In the agent details pane that opens, immediately under the agent's name, select **Block** or **Unblock**.

claims.claim: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block blocks a Copilot package to prevent its usage.

claims.quote: Searched: "Context IQ" agents skills identity actions governance block Work IQ; opened agent management, agent actions, registry, Work IQ overview, Business Applications default settings and Context IQ support. Agent access is governed; expanded-menu visibility is not specified.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified how the Business Applications Work IQ tenant setting affects expanded Context IQ menu choices.
claims.quote: Searched: "Context IQ" agents skills identity actions governance block Work IQ; opened Business Applications default settings, Work IQ overview and Context IQ support. The setting governs business-data access, but its effect on the expanded menu choices is not specified.

claims.where: Governance controls; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The documented Block action can restrict an agent selected from the inventory across the organisation.
claims.quote: **Block and unblock** | Restrict access to an agent across the organization, preventing any user from using it.

claims.claim: Work IQ is the only user-level menu control described by the cited support article.
claims.quote: Searched: "Context IQ" "Work IQ" files people meetings emails agents skills; read the complete Context IQ support article. Work IQ on/off is its only user-level reference-menu availability control; upload and attachment options select content.
